ask: this is a mess fix it
sentence: A group picks a fixed number of snacks to buy by voting on head-to-head matches, where each match winner goes on the buy list until it is full.
use_when: The chat needs to choose a few snacks from a longer list
People want a head-to-head vote instead of a plain poll
A shared buy list must be settled once most of the chat has voted
Deciding food or treats to get on a budget
dont_use_when: A single yes/no or one-question poll is enough
The choice is not between items, such as picking a time or place to meet
Splitting a bill or tracking who owes money
